title: Item:Splinterskull Battle Standard
wikitext:
[[Image:Splinterskull Battle Standard.png|right]]
This item can be found in the Level 11 quest [[The Spawn of Whisperdoom]]. Once outside the quest, the [[Ungurz Lieutenant]] will exchange the '''Splinterskull Battle Standard'''   for your choice from a short list of randomly generated items - the [[Item:Crystallized Widow's Eye|Crystallized Widow's Eye]] trinket has a rare chance to be in that list.
